# #3396: Patch: every Classic+ Alt art somewhere else: the same subject in a new place, time or moment, one brief per card
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

Part of #3330. Blocked by #3390, whose new pictures these Alt arts restage.

The owner asked (2026-11-06) to "go harder on alt art": keep the theme, but a different style or a different place, so each Alt art is clearly separate and stands out. "Every alt art probably needs a pass."

### Today (measured on `main` at `f330f5b`)

- Alt art redraws the card's own painter re-seeded (`artSeedOf`, R2940001): the same subject, with a backdrop grown from another seed. Its higher levels, Alt full art and up, draw the same picture (R3015002).
- 40 Classic+ cards are offered Alt art. They change a median 52% of their pixels, nearly all of it the sky behind the same subject; 7 change under 35%, the least Twice Forward One Step Backwards (16%), Wardrum (20%) and Book of Buff (22%).

### What it should be

- **Every card here gets an alt recipe.** Every card in the table, all the Classic+ cards offered `version-alt-art`, draws an alt scene recipe from its brief: the same subject and idea, in another place, time or story moment.
- **The same picture at every level.** The picture stays one per variant at every level (R3015002).
- **Measurably different.** An Alt picture changes at least `ALT_PICTURE_CHANGE_MIN` of its pixels from the card's normal picture (proposed 0.6, measured as the component spec measures `PICTURE_SHARE_MIN`). Its dominant hue or its composition differs too.
- **Not new variants.** #3017 adds new variants. This pass restages the existing Alt art picture.
- **Splitting.** The planner may split this into parts of about 40 cards each.

- The pull request holds the per-card table with each card's verdict.
- These still hold: R503's every-picture-differs test, the no-text checks, the base and Radiant geometry rule, and the palette test (R2725004). A Radiant face keeps its marks.
- There is a `--visual` fragment. Any ruling is in this issue's block, with the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`.
